interpretation.spread_definition: (max - min) / median of a side's useful-goodput values
interpretation.regression_rule: regression = 1 - median(candidate)/median(baseline); above max_median_regression fails even when ranges overlap
interpretation.saturation_rule: a run whose Jul CPU use over the measurement window is at least saturated_cpu_fraction of envelope_cpus is saturated; a throughput cell containing a saturated run is inconclusive
interpretation.calibration_rule: per protocol and variant, the largest calibration concurrency whose measured Jul CPU fraction on the ADR baseline is at most calibration_cpu_fraction with every response verified
interpretation.validity_rule: instrument validity: the run completed, canaries ran, the envelope was verified when required, every class started attempts inside its window using the planned protocol and connection count, and the client could build its requests. Runtime findings (unexpected status or error, unverified content, failed canary, Jul exit, OOM-kill delta, a nonzero governor lease/bytes/evaluation gauge after recovery (plan v3)) are recorded separately: a valid run with findings is evidence of incorrect behaviour and fails correctness in a comparison; it is never counted as goodput or dropped
interpretation.no_subset_selection: every attempted repetition is reported; an invalid, failed or inconclusive run is never dropped or replaced; added repetitions supplement it
interpretation.acceptance_boundary: an I5 result shows that the instrument captured a runtime; it is not A1-A18 acceptance. Throughput verdicts between the ADR baseline and post-I1 main are informational because I1 has no request-path enforcement

qualification.purpose: bounded large-body plugin-only request path at the default 256 MiB budget
changes_from_archive: static footprint sized per ADR 0032 §10: with default plugin pools (2 × 64 × 16 MiB) pre-freeze envelope smokes were OOM-killed on both the candidate and d8d0520b; max_instances 4 per plugin, a 2s plugin timeout (also bounding the finite instance wait) and GOMEMLIMIT=480MiB apply to both variants; a sized smoke with the 100ms default was dominated by pool-wait 503s and contained timeouts; the 256m budget stays at its default

qualification.purpose: deliberate enforce-mode byte saturation of the plugin request path (fail-fast 503 with probes)
changes_from_archive: 128m is above the 103825411 B compiled minimum of the two-plugin route (default plugin limits), so genuine validation passes; 160 concurrent 960 KiB bodies held 5 s at the origin need about 150 MiB of prepared capacity

plugin timeout 2s: a pre-freeze smoke with the 100ms default and a 1 s hold turned CPU contention between up to 64 concurrent 1 MB guest scans per plugin into contained guest timeouts (500) before the byte budget filled; the longer timeout and hold isolate the byte dimension and change no governor limit

static footprint sized per ADR 0032 §10 (not guaranteed: guest pools and GC headroom): with default pools (2 × 64 × 16 MiB = 2 GiB) a pre-freeze envelope smoke was OOM-killed at 593 MiB heap with 37 instances and 50 MiB governed; with 2 × 8 instances and no GOMEMLIMIT it was OOM-killed at 532 MiB heap with 126 MiB governed (GC headroom over a ~420 MiB live set)

max_instances 4 per plugin (128 MiB guest pool) and GOMEMLIMIT=480MiB, the ADR's recommendation: about 128 MiB governed + 128 MiB pool + baseline stays well below the limit, and the limit is below the 576 MiB objective
only a 503 with Retry-After: 1 and the inspection_overloaded body is the expected overload class; any other 503 is a finding
load and probe workers wait the advertised Retry-After after an overload response; p2h keeps the no-backoff shape as a separate record

qualification.purpose: p2 with clients that ignore Retry-After: records connection-buffer exposure of fast rejection (ADR 0032 §10, not guaranteed)
changes_from_archive: pre-freeze envelope smokes of the no-backoff shape were OOM-killed with governed bytes at 126 MiB: about 1300 rejected 960 KiB uploads per second each leave a connection in net/http's 500 ms close-write linger while the client keeps sending, and the unread bytes sit in kernel socket buffers charged to Jul's cgroup (memory.stat sock reached 286 MiB beside 393 MiB anon)
connection and kernel buffers are outside the governor (ADR 0032 §10); this cell is a record for I6 sizing, never a protection claim, and an OOM here is preserved as a finding

qualification.purpose: observe twin of p2: same load and budget, would-reject recorded, no governor rejection
non-body plugins: streamed bodies, request state and header-only subscription
plugin-only reload churn with budget decrease/increase, enforce/observe changes and an inadmissible reload, slow in-flight H2
changes_from_archive: reload i cycles max_buffered_bytes 128m, mode observe, 512m, 256m with the inspect-a name; reload 5 sets 1m, below the route minimum, and must be refused with the previous limits kept

each budget reload waits up to 10 s for its jul_reload_total sighup outcome and then reads the effective limits from GET /api/v1/status; a missing acknowledgement, an unexpected outcome or effective limits other than those expected is a runtime finding

static footprint sized as p1 (max_instances 4, plugin timeout 2s, GOMEMLIMIT=480MiB): with default pools a pre-freeze envelope smoke was OOM-killed at 759 MiB with near-zero governed bytes, about 24 leases and at most 13 instances, heap growing across overlapping generations

waits 5 s after each reload and its acknowledgement instead of 2 s (an inter-step delay, not a fixed cadence): pre-freeze smokes at 2 s were OOM-killed with sized pools on both the candidate (752 MiB) and main d8d0520b (714 MiB) after about 8 reloads with zero governed bytes; at 5 s main completed (peaks 650 to 687 MiB) but kept about 495 MiB of heap in use after two GCs, mostly wazero guest memory and decoded modules of retired generations with only 2 live instances; that pre-existing generation retention is a recorded finding outside I2, so the cell asserts reload acknowledgement and governor drain, not the 576 MiB peak objective

fewer than 5 acknowledged budget reloads (so the inadmissible step 5 never ran) makes the run unexercised; after recovery every governor lease, bytes and evaluation gauge must be zero, a nonzero one is a runtime finding and missing gauges make the run unexercised
